title: C15 Cart state (persisted, hydration-safe, reconciled on login)

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: Cart state is shared across routes within the challenge and persisted (localStorage or cookie) so it survives a reload; an add reflects optimistically before any async settle.
Hydration is safe: the persisted cart does not cause an SSR/client text-content mismatch (no hydration warning in console) — the solution documents the deferred-read/mount-gate technique used.

On login the guest cart reconciles with the server-side saved cart per the documented strategy with no items silently dropped; reconciliation reads the current user via the FROZEN lib/auth getSession (QA functional: cart add, persist, and login-reconciliation flow works end to end).
NOTES.md documents the Context vs Zustand tradeoff and justifies the choice made.

The c15 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; auth is consumed via the frozen interface only and neither lib/auth nor lib/data is edited.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
